caption: The drawing depicts a detailed rendering of a metallic-looking container or vessel, possibly an urn or lamp, colored in monochromatic shades of gray and black. The vessel is centrally placed within a rectangular border and features a domed lid with two parallel protruding rods or wicks emerging from the top. The main body of the vessel is bulbous and tapers downward, attaching to a wide, conical base that sits in a shallow circular tray. Two symmetrical, vertical handles connect the upper part of the vessel to the outer rim. To the left, there is a small inset diagram at the top corner showing a simplified and dimensioned side view of the vessel. The background is a light beige color, and there is a noticeable reddish-brown stain on the left side of the page. The drawing includes shading to indicate depth and has a fine signature, "M. Marzocchi," at the bottom right of the main illustration.
title: Swinging Lamp
